name: Awake
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level adept 1, bard 1, psychic 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (some smelling salts)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area one or more living creatures within a 10-ft.-radius burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You release a burst of energy that causes all creatures within the burst to be instantly awakened, regardless of the means by which they were put to sleep. This also dispels the effects of the spell lullaby or similar effects that makes the target more prone to sleep specifically.
